newsitem.title: UK: M&S down on UK interest rate worries.
newsitem.headline: M&S down on UK interest rate worries.

text.p: Shares in Marks & Spencer Plc led UK retail stocks lower on Thursday after stronger-than-expected inflation data fuelled worries over rising UK interest rates, traders said.

Shares in Marks & Spencer dropped 9-1/2p to 475p by 1146 GMT and other retail stocks were also lower, with Boots Co Plc down 4p at 601, Kingfisher Plc down 8p at 610-1/2 and Argos Plc down 13p at 754-1/2.
"There's no other story apart from interest rate worries," said a trader at one leading securities house.

Retailers have been among the best performing UK shares this year on the back of rising growth and a recovery in consumer spending, yet rates have already been raised once and further increases could bear down on consumer activity next year.
The UK Retail Price Index was up 2.7 percent in October versus a year before, at the top of the range of analysts' forecasts.
